nodes.label: Agara Coffee
nodes.rationale: Combines premium coffee with functional ingredients (Lion's Mane, Chromemate Chromium, Green Coffee Bean, Berberine HCL, Saffron, Lotus Leaf, Citrus Aurantium, L-Theanine) for clean sustained energy, focus, and wellness support without unverified medical claims.

nodes.label: MATCHAGARA
nodes.rationale: Ceremonial-grade organic matcha combined with Lion's Mane mushroom, L-Theanine, Berberine HCL, Chromemate Chromium, Saffron, Lotus Leaf, and Citrus Aurantium for sustained energy, sharper focus, and mood balance.

nodes.label: Wake Focus Restore Ritual Arc

nodes.label: Matcha Support Image (support-image-a.png)
nodes.rationale: High-key horizontal matcha composition with editorial typography 'ELEVATE YOUR DAY' and MatchAgara pouch for full-bleed matcha product intro strip.

nodes.label: Coffee Support Image (support-image-b.png)
nodes.rationale: Warm ivory and copper horizontal coffee composition pairing with matcha image for deliberate two-panel product ritual chapter.

nodes.label: Agara Research & Claim Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Treat brand ingredient lists as reported claims rather than verified dosages, distinguish general ingredient science from finished product claims, and avoid disease-treatment, weight-loss, detox, and blood-sugar claims on public pages.

nodes.label: Botanical Editorial Ritual Design Direction
nodes.rationale: Contemporary botanical editorialism with quiet-luxury packaging cues, tactile still-life composition, asymmetric calm, material honesty, and ritual over rush.

nodes.label: Agara Color Philosophy & Copper
nodes.rationale: Built from quiet cream ground, living matcha green, roasted espresso, and signature Agara Copper #B86538 connecting matcha and coffee through elevation.

nodes.label: Leaf-Flame Monogram & Wordmark
nodes.rationale: Uppercase wordmark with custom copper caret and two opposing tapered forms meeting at a calm central point symbolizing botanical calm and roasted energy.

nodes.label: Agara Typography System
nodes.rationale: Pairs Cormorant Garamond for editorial statements and poetic titles with DM Sans for navigation, UI controls, and readable body text.

nodes.label: Media Cropping Fix & Containment
nodes.rationale: Resolves viewport cropping by switching editorial creatives to full-frame containment while preserving hero emphasis.

nodes.label: Research-Informed Product Education Plan
nodes.rationale: Specifies requirements to identify authoritative sources, separate label claims from general science, and add cited ingredients section with cautious wording.

nodes.label: Clinical Modern Vitality Direction
nodes.rationale: Bright evidence-led direction built around crisp product diagrams and mineral whites, rejected in favor of Botanical Editorial Ritual.

nodes.label: Roasted Atelier Direction
nodes.rationale: Dark cinematic coffee-house direction with ember copper and deep espresso, evaluated as alternative candidate.
